doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Floor-show tunes and comedians
summary: They played fast numbers for shows; Pokechop and Yeah Man were the comedians.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Oh, what tune I played for the show? He played, what number? See, what the thing? I was thinking of the thing.
Fast numbers. All the fast numbers. All the mixed. Because you used to dance, different numbers. I got risen. Some tried to sing.
I got risen. All the fast numbers. You know.
We had Pokechop. Pokechop and Yeah Man. He was the comedian. Yeah, he did. Pokechop and Yeah Man.
That's not the same Pokechop as a dancing today, huh? I don't know if Pokechop and Yeah Man could be.

I ain't seen them boys in a long time. Pokechop and Kidney Stood that left with? No, that was at Luchin Till. That was at Luchin Till. Yeah. Well, we had a Pokechop out there, but he was cool. He could get a good age already now, I imagine. Of course, I'm a Pokechop.
